newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - April 8.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Four indicted for allegedly embezzling more than NT$100 million from temple in Tainan, southern Taiwan
Education ministry approves regulations to promote university education
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Harvard Business School Professor Michael Porter says Taiwan should concentrate on developing Asia-Pacific high-technology centre
Offshore shipping centre expected to start operation at end-April; Taiwan to approve shipping applications by five Chinese shippers
LIBERTY TIMES - Harvard's Porter urges Taiwan to concentrate on developing high-tech centre, says Taiwan's other Asia-Pacific business hub plans too complicated
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Chinese Vice Premier Qian Qichen meets some 20 Taiwan executives in Xiamen
Legislators hold public hearing on second Taiwan stock exchange
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Underwriting prices of rights issues by companies must come close to market prices
March export and import values maintain double-digit growth
